# Unmapped

[Lodestar](../Forces/Classes/Lodestar.md)-class survey vessel, in SV-03 Unmapped. Commanding officer: Sub-Lieutenant [Earnest Stilldale](../People/Earnest-Stilldale.md).

Survey vessel SV-03 under [Earnest Stilldale](../People/Earnest-Stilldale.md). Her surveys found the Accord's first alien ruins, on Nyrene II and Phaedre II.
